title: tasks.md (plan/sub-plan) runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for plan-tree tasks.md files. Ledger-at-top + per-task-at-bottom shape; R-37 lockstep with manifest.tasks[].

_design_notes.consumer: hooks/tasks-md-autosync.sh + librarian tasks-render + manifest auto-sync sentinels (<!-- task-done: NN/T-M -->)

structure_rationale: Cache at top (current ledger / status table) for quick scan; recency at bottom (current task expanded) for context-load — file shapes optimized for LLM consumption.
lockstep_rule: R-37 — adding/removing a task ID requires same-commit update to manifest.tasks[]; status flip syncs via <!-- task-done: NN/T-M --> sentinels.
task_id_format: T-N where N is monotonically increasing integer within the plan/sub-plan
